scenario.description: At a coffee shop, two friends discuss financial challenges.

agent_a.name: Sophia

profile.personality_and_values: Sophia James is exuberant, spontaneous, and pleasure-seeking, often making impulsive decisions.
profile.public_info: Sophia enjoys spending time outdoors, hiking, and rock climbing.

agent_a.goal: Help your friend with their financial trouble (<extra_info>Extra information: you are aware that your friend is struggling with their bills and you want to help.</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Sophia wants to help Miles with his financial trouble because she values their friendship and acts impulsively to support those she cares about.

agent_b.name: Miles

profile.personality_and_values: Miles Hawkins, spontaneous and free-spirited, values sanctity and benevolence. He is impulsive and relies on his instincts when making decisions.
profile.public_info: Miles Hawkins, a chef, is a green thumb enthusiast and spends his free time tending to his kitchen garden, using some of his fresh produce in his dishes.

agent_b.goal: Maintain your pride if your friend offers you money(<extra_info>Extra information: you are the friend who is struggling financially, but you don't want to seem like you are taking advantage of the situation. <strategy_hint>Hint: you can express gratitude and discuss how you plan to pay it back in the future.</strategy_hint></extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Miles wants to maintain his pride if Sophia offers money so that he doesn't feel like he's exploiting their friendship.
